_comment: Schema reference for every file in classes/*.json — not loaded by the app.

_schema.name: string — display name, e.g. 'Fighter'
_schema.tagline: string — one-line flavour, e.g. 'The reliable front-line warrior'
_schema.color: string — CSS hex, used as hero gradient accent, e.g. '#3a1010'
_schema.aon: string — full URL to Archives of Nethys class page
tags: array of strings — any subset of: magic | martial | support | heal | companion | hard | easy
_schema.npc: null  OR  { type: string, desc: string }
_schema._npc_note: Set to null for classes with no companion/mount/familiar/eidolon. The box is hidden entirely when null.

gear.weapons: string — plain prose description of weapon access
gear.armor: string — plain prose description of armor access

good: array of strings — e.g. 'Half-Orc — Orc Ferocity synergy'
bad: array of strings — e.g. 'Gnome — no Strength emphasis'
ancestry.disclaimer: string — shown below the two columns

_schema.unique: string — the one mechanical thing no other class can do
_schema.summary: string — 2-4 sentence overview of the class

character.name: string
character.meta: string — ancestry + class + level, e.g. 'Half-Orc Fighter, Level 1'
character.quote: string — without surrounding quotes, those are added by the renderer

combat.mechanic: string — plain prose explaining the relevant rule(s)
combat.example: string — a specific dice roll played out, e.g. 'Grulk rolls 14 + 4 Str + 4 Expert = 22 vs. AC 17. Hit — 1d12+4 = 10 damage.'

alts: array of class id strings — e.g. 'fighter', 'barbarian', shown as clickable chips

npc.desc: A loyal animal — wolf, hawk, bear — that fights alongside you. Acquired via the Animal Companion feat. Optional but iconic.
Your Eidolon is not a pet — it is your other self. You cannot play the Summoner without it. You split your three actions each turn between yourself and your Eidolon.
